items.description: Printr provided a fully featured 3D printing api that allows developers to create and connect all types of applications to 3D printing and directly to 3D printers.
Lets people reprint public domain books from Internet Archive and Google Books.
TwitShop uses the real-time power of Twitter to search for personal sale, trade and auction items.
PriceCanopy is an automated repricing solution for sellers on Amazon.com. Combines competitive information from Amazon MWS and retailers' custom pricing rules to set optimal prices on listings.
Free carpool matching service based on home location and work location.

CoverSlide helps track down lost cover art for mp3s, movies, books, and video games. Ruby on Rails and Ajax make it convenient to select from a vast amount of cover art thumbnails to choose the perfect one without leaving the page.

Need to create a map for your Facebook page? Why send readers to a google or mapquest map when you could give them another reason to go to your Facebook page instead? Or keep them on your Facebook page. The BlockWild map application gives you the ability to create a map with an informative popup card on your Facebook page for events, rentals, classifieds, or anything you want to map.
Topix includes deals and daily deals on their map portion of their page. All deals sourced by 8coupons.

MyGuestmap allows your visitors to add pins to a map showing where they are and leaving a message. Create a map to allow your website visitors to place pins, a bookmark-map where only you can post, password-protected maps, and upload photos.
A fun and educational way to track the status of U.S. legislation, highlighting the actual locations where law gets made.
Plots points and tracks from GPX files onto Virtual Earth maps.
Renkler means colors in Turkish. This site has colors for Turkey. Still developing. It uses related colors and palettes from COLOURlovers.
Follow the progress of CBS television show The Amazing Race via the Goolge Map mashup.

A comprehensive guide for coastal activities with specific information on all UK beaches. Uses Google Maps, OpenStreetMap and a number of smaller APIs for weather. Whether you are looking for a beach holiday, a day at the coast, a coastal path walk, information on beaches, tourist attractions or energetic sports activities, this site and social channels has the details.
ShooSpy monitors what people are buying on Zappos in realtime.
Allows Box.net users to view analytics about files they have shared through Box.
A mashup of 100 cities and their weather forecasts from weatherunderground.com. The 100 cities listed are the cities where history shows you are most likely to sweat while there.
Using the Google Translate API, this web app shows translations of any English word into over 30 European languages, on a map.
This mashup allows Box.net users to share files from within their Box accounts using Twitter.
Get simple information on any website: owner, location, daily visitors, IP neighbors and other stuff that your mom can understand.
Whatsikat Boso shows how Filipino bloggers are feeling right now. It extracts feelings from Filipino blogs. Take a peek into their moods and see how that makes you feel.
Home Fish lists over 347,000 government owned foreclosures on an easy to use Google Map. Search listings by ZIP code.
Find out estimated carbon emissions and fuel costs based on the driving directions you provide. Enter your daily commute or any other trip. View various ideas about how to reduce your emissions.
Anyone can send 140 character reviews to the LouderVoice reviews site from Twitter.
Allows Box.net users to send sharing links to content in their Box account through Gmail.
Post and share events for free. Get local event information on your cell phone. Post and share invites. Uses the Eventful API.
Populate your jplayer playlist with a bandcamp artist discography.
Twitter realtime feed. iGoogle style drag and drop with Twitter power search. Search current daily and weekly trends. Search TwitPics and audio.
PDFCast.org is a free PDF file sharing tool. Upload your PDF documents and share with the world. Integrates with Google Book Search viewer.
Thank to the vzaar API users can upload and share their favourite videos.
FYIfly leverages the Active.com API to show different active events based on location.
Cuevox is a meeting reminder service but with a twist. At the proper time, Cuevox will call your attendees and ask them if they would be on time or not. Cuevox then lets you know.
